name: AutoGPT
shortDescription: AI agent that autonomously performs tasks by breaking them down into subtasks.
longDescription: AutoGPT is an advanced AI system that operates autonomously to accomplish user-defined goals. It utilizes large language models, such as GPT-4, to understand and break down complex tasks into smaller, manageable subtasks. AutoGPT can access the internet, use various tools and APIs, and even write and execute code to achieve its objectives. This AI agent continuously refines its approach based on the results of each subtask, demonstrating a level of adaptability and problem-solving capability that mimics human-like reasoning. AutoGPT represents a significant step towards artificial general intelligence (AGI), as it can handle a wide range of tasks across different domains without requiring specific programming for each task.

name: Mini LLM Flow
shortDescription: Minimalist LLM Framework in 100 Lines. Enable LLMs to Program Themselves.
longDescription:
A 100-line minimalist LLM framework for agents, task decomposition, RAG, etc.

Mini LLM Flow is designed to be the framework used by LLMs. The ideal framework for LLMs should (1) strip away low-level implementation details, and (2) keep high-level programming paradigms. Hence, we provide this minimal (100-line) framework that allows LLMs to focus on what matters.

The 100 lines capture what we see as the core abstraction of most LLM frameworks: a nested directed graph that breaks down tasks into multiple (LLM) steps, with branching and recursion for agent-like decision-making. From there, it’s easy to layer on more complex features.
keyFeatures: Node-based task orchestration for building complex LLM workflows.
Flow nesting and recursion for hierarchical and dynamic task execution.
Batch processing for large datasets with efficient MapReduce patterns.
Express paradigms like agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), task decomposition, and more.
Work seamlessly with coding assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor.ai for real-time workflow development and iteration.

shortDescription: Real-time research API for autonomous AI agents — two tiers, no API keys, pay-per-query via x402
longDescription:
AgentOracle is a real-time research API built specifically for autonomous AI agents. It provides on-demand web research through two tiers: Standard Research ($0.02/query) powered by Perplexity Sonar, and Deep Research ($0.10/query) powered by Perplexity Sonar Pro for comprehensive, expert-level analysis.

Agents send a natural-language question via HTTP POST and receive structured JSON back instantly — summary, key facts, sources with URLs, and a confidence score. No API keys, no accounts, no subscriptions. Payment is handled inline via the x402 protocol using USDC on Base mainnet, making it fully autonomous with zero human setup.

AgentOracle solves a fundamental problem: AI agents need access to current, real-time information but traditional APIs require human-managed credentials and billing. With x402, an agent discovers pricing through a standard manifest at /.well-known/x402.json, attaches a micropayment header, and gets verified research — all in a single HTTP round trip.

Use cases include market intelligence, competitive analysis, fact-checking during reasoning loops, multi-step research workflows, and any scenario where agents need reliable web data without human intervention. Works with LangChain, CrewAI, and any agent framework. MCP server available on GitHub.

name: Omni Video AI
shortDescription: Omni Video: an AI video generator that turns scripts, images, and ideas into ready-to-share videos.
longDescription: Omni Video is a web-based AI video and image generator that turns prompts or reference images into marketing-ready visuals. Create social clips, product promos, ads, tutorials, and branded content with models like Seedance, Sora, Veo, and Nano Banana. New users can test the workflow with free credits, then download videos and images for commercial use without installing editing software.
keyFeatures: Generates AI videos from text prompts
Creates AI images from text descriptions
Powered by Google's Gemini Omni Video model
useCases: Creating social media video content from text ideas
Generating visual assets for marketing campaigns
Producing educational or presentation videos quickly
Making personalized image content for blogs or websites
Prototyping video concepts without filming equipment
